text: London, 1969. Two young Australians saw a lion cub for sale in a department store — and bought him. They named him Christian. He grew up in their furniture shop in Chelsea. When he got too big, they took him to Kenya to live wild. A year later they went back. *He was a wild lion now.* Then he saw them — and *ran straight into their arms.* Like if animals never forget.
title: The Lion Never Forgot Them 🦁❤️
